inputs.name: hand over from Model Registry to CI/CD Pipeline

output.level_0: The registry rejects valid models, so the pipeline cannot fetch any new version to test.
output.level_1: No registry exists, so the pipeline pulls model files from a shared drive folder.
output.level_2: A developer manually copies the model file from the registry into the pipeline workspace.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically fetches the latest registered model version whenever a new build starts.
output.level_4: The pipeline verifies registry signatures and logs every model handover for audit compliance.
